en.headline: Triad leader charged with murder over Tsim Sha Tsui bar attack
en.dek: A 40-year-old man known as Left Mouth faces a murder charge and a 52-year-old faces a charge of assisting an offender after the fatal assault on a 32-year-old businessman last month.
body: Police have charged a 40-year-old triad leader known as Left Mouth with murder in connection with the fatal assault on a businessman at a Tsim Sha Tsui bar.

A 52-year-old man was charged with assisting an offender. The case was due to be heard at Kowloon City Magistrates’ Courts on Tuesday. The victim, 32-year-old Isaac Yeung, was attacked during a birthday party on Cameron Road in the early hours of 26 July after an altercation involving suspected Wo Shing Wo triad members. He suffered severe head injuries and died on 31 July.
A total of 12 people have been arrested in the case. Six others were earlier charged with murder or assisting an offender. Police are still seeking another triad figure known as Wai-Kin.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀酒吧謀殺案 三合會頭目左咀被控謀殺
zh.dek: 一名40歲外號「左咀」的三合會頭目被控謀殺，另一名52歲男子被控協助罪犯，案件與上月尖沙咀酒吧致命襲擊有關。
body: 警方就尖沙咀酒吧致命襲擊案，控告一名40歲外號「左咀」的三合會頭目謀殺罪。
另一名52歲男子被控協助罪犯。案件定於周二在九龍城裁判法院提堂。死者32歲楊姓商人，7月26日凌晨在金馬倫道一間酒吧生日派對期間，與懷疑和勝和成員發生爭執後遭襲擊，頭部重傷，7月31日不治。
案件共12人被捕，其中六人較早前已因謀殺或協助罪犯被控。警方仍在通緝另一名外號「威健」的三合會人物。
